title: No all-caps text anywhere
why: His hard rule (2026-10-18): nothing shown to the player is ever in all caps. Every canvas draw and every menu text node already passes through the TX door, so words of 3+ capital letters (not SP, XP, HP, LMG, SMG, DMR, KIA, HUD, FPS and the like) are made sentence case there, and the CSS text-transform:uppercase is removed. The tab title is Pillagers.
now: All text shows in sentence case, never in capitals.
